# Maatram

> Maatram is a free focus and digital wellbeing app for students, built by class 10B at SSVM School of Excellence. It cuts screen time with an app gate, focus timers, live study rooms and a points system. Every tool opens without an account; signing in (Google only) saves points. Web app plus an Android build and a Chrome extension. Tagline: Bringing a change in you.

Everything on the site runs on one points balance: finishing focus sessions, study-room time and Wellness daily checks pays points, breaking an app lock costs them.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://maatram.co.in/): what Maatram is, its six tools (Focus Timers, App Gate, Study Room, Screen Stats, Leaderboard, Wellness), FAQ.
- [Focus Timers](https://maatram.co.in/timers.html): Pomodoro 25/5 and Deep Work 90/15 timers with points and streaks.
- [App Gate](https://maatram.co.in/app-gate.html): hard lock for social apps, 5 to 90 minutes.
- [Study Room](https://maatram.co.in/study-room.html): five students on one room code, synced timers, strikes and chat.
- [Screen Stats](https://maatram.co.in/stats.html): daily per-app screen-time logging, weekly charts and bonus.
- [Leaderboard](https://maatram.co.in/leaderboard.html): live ranking of signed-in students by points.
- [Wellness](https://maatram.co.in/wellness/wellness.html): private 7-day meal plan and four daily checks (meals, hydration, activity, sleep), +25 points each, up to +100 a day. Plan and checks stay on the device.
- [Sports Corner](https://maatram.co.in/sports.html): local sports events listed by signed-in users; register links go to the organisers.
- [Download](https://maatram.co.in/download.html): Android app (APK v1.1).
- [Maatram Hard Lock Chrome extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/maatram-hard-lock/igcfbmdadjlibodcpaibklgeijdacmen): blocks Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok, YouTube, X and Facebook in Chrome during a Hard Lock and counts time on them for Screen Stats.
